newsitem.title: USA: CME live cattle calls mixed, feeders steady to off.
newsitem.headline: CME live cattle calls mixed, feeders steady to off.

text.p: Early calls on CME live cattle futures ranged from 0.200 cent per lb higher in the nearby contract to as much as 0.200 lower in back months while feeder cattle were expected steady to 0.200 lower, analysts said.

August live cattle could trade steady to higher following the strength in both fed cattle and boxed beef prices on Tuesday. Packers paid $66 per cwt, up $2, for cash cattle Tuesday which should support the nearby, analysts said.
However, expectations of increased fed cattle supplies ahead and a spike in the sales volume Tuesday, which could indicate a top in the market, could again press deferreds, they said.
Feeder cattle futures will likely show carryover weakness on climbing corn futures values. Rising feed costs is tempering demand for replacement feeders at feedlots, sources noted.
A lower CME feeder cattle index should also weigh on sentiment, they added, referring to the latest CME feeder cattle index which was off $0.18 at $82.38 per cwt.
